message.content: {"caption":"A process diagram of an agent archive feeding a self-modification and benchmark-evaluation loop, with repository and task workflows shown at right.","description":"At left, a rounded gray area labeled “Archive” contains a branching lineage of circular agents: a gray top node connects to a gray node on the left and a red node labeled “parent”; the left gray node branches to two gray lower nodes, while the red parent connects to a yellow node labeled “child.” Nearby text identifies the red node as a “Coding agent” and the yellow node as a “New coding agent.” A thick black loop surrounds the central process: its upper arc is labeled “select” and leads from the archive toward the green “Self-modify” box, marked with a wrench icon; its lower arc passes the blue “Evaluate on benchmark” box, marked with a magnifying-glass icon, and returns toward the archive along an arrow labeled “add.” At right, the upper gray workflow combines a computer/repository icon labeled “Coding agent’s own repo” with a message icon labeled “Self-improve instruction”; an arrow leads to a circle labeled “Coding agent,” then an arrow to “Code Diff: Feature to improve itself,” beside a branching-code icon. A dashed curved arrow leads from this upper code-diff output down to the lower workflow’s dashed circle labeled “New coding agent.” The lower workflow combines a computer/repository icon labeled “Task repo (e.g., GitHub repo)” with a message icon labeled “Task instruction (e.g., GitHub issue)”; an arrow leads to the new coding agent, followed by an arrow to “Code Diff: Solve task,” beside another branching-code icon. The small computer icons denote repositories, the message icons denote instructions, the wrench denotes self-modification, the magnifying glass denotes benchmark evaluation, and the branching icons denote code changes.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
